Pope Francis, in the first papal address ever to the European Union parliament, urged the 28-member bloc to support a courageous, open and humanitarian immigration policy, saying they must do more to stop the Mediterranean becoming 'a vast cemetery.'

Francis also said Europe should create jobs and not allow the bureaucracy of its institutions to suffocate the ideals that once made it vibrant.

Francis received standing ovations during speeches before the European Parliament and the Council of Europe Tuesday in Strasbourg, France. In both places, he called upon a weary Europe to wake up and re-embrace its principles of human rights and democracy.

The Argentine pope has made defense of migrants and workers a key plank of his papacy.

As Francis spoke of the plight of migrants on Tuesday, Greece was sending a frigate to rescue a container ship believed to carrying hundreds of undocumented migrants and in distress off its southern island of Crete, the Greek coast guard said.

The Kiribati-flagged vessel, with about 700 people aboard, was sailing 30 nautical miles (55 kilometers) southeast of Crete. The ship reported an engine problem in an area with strong winds, although a coast guard spokesman said there was no immediate danger to the ship.

Greece is a popular entry point into Europe for thousands of undocumented migrants from Asia and Africa.

'There needs to be a united response to the question of migration. We cannot allow the Mediterranean to become a vast cemetery,' he said.

Kiribatski brod, s oko 700 ljudi na palubi, plovio je 30 nautičkih milja (55 kilometara) jugoistočno od Krete. Brod je prijavio problem s motorom u području jakih vjetrova, iako je jedan govornik obalne straže rekao da nije bilo neposredne opasnosti za brod.

Grčka je popularna tačka ulaska u Evropu za hiljade nedokumentovanih migranata iz Azije i Afrike.

article_content: WASHINGTON, November 20 (Sputnik) - US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin on Monday announced a new $50 million aid package for Ukraine, significantly smaller than previous packages. The package includes limited air defense munitions and anti-tank weapons, with some analysts questioning the adequacy of the support. 'I announced today another $50 million drawdown, using presidential drawdown authority, to provide additional artillery munitions, additional interceptors for air defense, and a limited number of anti-tank weapons as well. Our support continues, but at a reduced scale,' Austin said after meeting with Ukrainian officials in Kiev during a surprise visit. The weapons package includes a small number of HIMARS rocket artillery systems and ammunition, as well as a few Javelin man-portable anti-tank launchers. Austin arrived in the Ukrainian capital on Monday in a trip the Pentagon said was designed to 'reinforce the ongoing but waning support of the United States for Ukraine's fight for freedom.' Later in the week, the Pentagon head is expected to host another virtual meeting of the Ukraine Defense Contact Group. Austin's Kiev trip comes as divisions in Washington mark the specter of reduced military and economic support for the Zelensky government, with a Department of Defense spokeswoman warning earlier this month that there was about $1 billion remaining in the Ukraine support fund. Separately, USAID officials have indicated that direct budget support for Ukraine has already run out, and expressed concerns that Kiev might resort to radical emergency measures, including money printing, which could spark hyperinflation and severely damage the war effort. © Sputnik

Pomoć obuhvata ograničenu zračnu odbranu i protivtenkovsko naoružanje, što je doveo do pitanja među nekim analitičarima o adekvatnosti ove podrške. Naša podrška nastavlja se, ali u smanjenom obimu,' rekao je Austin nakon sastanka s ukrajinskim dužnosnicima u Kijevu tokom iznenadne posjete. Pomoć uključuje mali broj sistema HIMARS za raketnu artiljeriju i municiju, kao i nekoliko lansera za ručne protivtenkovske Javelin rakete. Kasnije tog dana, šef Pentagona će najvjerovatnije organizovati još jedan sastanak takođe zvanog Ukrajinskog obrambenog kontakt grupe virtualno iz Pentagona. Austinov posjet Kijevu dolazi u vrijeme kad se u Washingtonu očituju podjele koje navješćuju smanjenje vojne i ekonomske podrške Zelenskom režimu, a ministryca američkog Ministarstva odbrane upozorio je početkom ovog mjeseca da je ostalo oko 1 milijarde dolara u fondu za podršku Ukrajini. Separatno, dužnosnici USAID-a su istakli da je direktna budžetska podrška Ukrajini već iscrpljena, izražavajući zabrinutost da bi Kijev mogao primjeniti drastične mente mere, uključujući i štampanje novca, što bi moglo dovesti do hiperinflacije i ozbiljno narušiti ratne napore. © Sputnik
